title: The Yushi Rover drives on the tank's ground: routed round rock, walls, buildings and sinkholes, drawn on its road
context: Owner's playtest note, 2026-11-12 evening: "yushi-rover must have the same collision logic as the tank; walls, rocks, etc." Branch rover-collide from 5c6d3b52, unpushed. Before: the tank's free drive refuses a point that is off the lattice, on a BLOCKED cell (ROCK, and the WALL cells once the gate step stands), in a life container, within an open sinkhole's pad (crater r + 0.6 cells), on the Terraformer's pad, inside a building solid to the hull (story-base solidAt), in a door's span while it is under 85 % open (gateShut, with gateEase slowing it) or on a standing spawn point, plus its footprint against the rock faces. The rover routed by BFS round BLOCKED cells and buildings 2 m out only: it drove through the sinkhole pads, took a goal on any cell (bfsPath admits a blocked goal), ignored the containers, the pad, the spawn points and the door, and was drawn chasing a point that ran along the cell centres, so it cut across every corner it turned at.
outcome: src/domain/drive-ground.js holds the tank's ground as one pure rule (groundBlock: off, rock, container, breach, pedestal; driveBlock adds solid, padded, and unit); td-tab's freeBlocked calls groundBlock on `hullGround` (the same tests in the same order, the same hullWhy words), and the rover routes over cells where driveBlock(centre) is '' with buildings ROVER.road.pad 2 m out. A goal on blocked ground (a pile in a sinkhole's pad or on a wall, a flare in a building's pad) is reached from the nearest open cell within ROVER.reach of it, where it rakes from (run.stand). src/domain/rover-road.js turns the path's centres into the drawn road: the string pulled where a run and 2.5 m either side are clear by the same rule, the corners rounded (8 m, then 4, 2; else kept sharp); the run's length is the road's, the drawn rover stands on the road's point and faces along it (src/fx/rover.js road targets), no chase. The road ahead is rechecked every ROVER.recheck 1 s: a cell gone (a wall, a building, a sinkhole) sends it round by a new path (REROUTE); no path holds it where it is drawn with NO ROAD / NO ROAD HOME on the console, asked again every second, never jumping. A door shut 6 m ahead (gateShut, the tank's own test) holds it on the road until it is open enough. The depot hops (pad, dock) and the pearls are unchanged (they are not solid to the tank either). The --rover suite now flags the open cell nearest the richest ground (the richest ground lay in the sinkhole's pad, where the tank cannot stand).
alternatives: A push-out collider on the drawn rover (the tank's slide): an autonomous vehicle that only collides wedges; routing over the same ground keeps it moving.
A second passability rule for the rover: the owner asked for the tank's; the rule is extracted once and the tank calls it too.
Driving to the flare's own cell when it is blocked (round 8): that is what put the rover in the sinkhole; the rim within the flare's reach rakes the same ground.
A* instead of BFS: BFS over the lattice plus the pulled string gives near-shortest drawn roads; not needed.
evidence: Before (5c6d3b52 + the same sampler, --rover's first trip, flare on the richest cell): 444 of 1,581 sampled frames on blocked ground, all `breach` (the rover drove into the open sinkhole's pad to its flare), 25 frames inside a shut door's span; ROVER TRIP out->arrive 26.4 s, back 30.3 s, road 405.3 m (the brief's base: 27.6 / 30.8 / 422.9). No rock or building was crossed on that trip; the corner cut and the rock/wall goals are code findings, not measured.

After (scripts/browser-lock.sh node scripts/browser-test.mjs --rover, PASS 7: harvest, unload, after, hunted, escorted, reroute, no-road): ROVER TRIP out->arrive 24.1 s, harvest 12.3 s, back 27.0 s, unload 4.9 s, 4,840 kg, road out 355.6 m / home 356.2 m (another run on other ground: 29.8 / 32.3 s over 446 / 441 m); ROVER GROUND trip 1,622 frames, 0 blocked, 0 in a shut door, 36 frames waiting at the gate, 11 with a wheel side 2.5 m out on blocked ground (printed); the whole suite 9,566 frames, 0 blocked, 0 gate, edge 144. REROUTE: the widest cell 62 m out shut, a new road of 280 m never used it and reached the flare; NO ROAD: the ring round its cell shut on the way home, NO ROAD HOME, moved 0.00 m in 3 s, home once reopened. Hunted: unescorted 1,000 kg bitten, home 4,963 kg; escorted 0 bitten, 6,000 kg.

test/drive-ground.mjs, test/rover-road.mjs (round a rock block, no point on it, the direction never jumps over 0.5 rad), test/rover-run.mjs (a wall built mid-trip: round it; no way round: held, noted once, no jump; NO ROAD HOME; a pile on a blocked cell raked from beside; a door holds it). npm test 346 programs; npm run check green (td-tab 5,352 under 5,450, no long line).

Other suites on 5e2ccd94: --dog-scout PASS 7 (the first harvest 317 kg, was 323); --gunship-ff PASS 1; --story-world red twice at step 16 'spent cases fell from the Rotor in sentry control' (15 PASS before it), and red at the same step on the clean base 5c6d3b52 (15 PASS): a base red, not this change.
